verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a Shopify app that voids or captures authorizations, restocks and sends cancellation emails based on decisions. They also document an SFCC/Agentforce Commerce cartridge, a Magento extension, and automated chargeback gateway integrations for Stripe, Adyen, Braintree and PayPal that work without custom API code, so the core 'not just a raw API' need is met. missing for 10: any BigCommerce integration evidence, PSP integrations beyond chargeback handling (e.g. fraud-decision flows inside the gateway), evidence of ongoing maintenance or versioning of the connectors, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
